data.name: Dungeon Killer
data.detailed_description:
Dungeon Killer

Death has a price. Astrid is willing to pay it in blood.

Dungeon Killer is an intense 2D boss rush shoot ’em up featuring horror elements, visual novel-style storytelling, and fast-paced combat.

Play as Astrid, the eldest of the Nova Queens, a woman consumed by grief after the death of her husband. Unable to accept her loss, she steals confidential data from Nova Labs to locate a dungeon inhabited by Yin-Yan, the Goddess of Death herself. Her goal is simple: demand the resurrection of her beloved.

If the dungeon's creatures try to stop her, Astrid will not hesitate to carve her way through them.

Armed with a devastating experimental minigun capable of firing different colored ammunition, you must adapt to increasingly complex attack patterns as you descend into the depths of a realm where death rules over all things.

Face Monstrous Bosses

Each boss features unique mechanics, attack patterns, and personalities.

Milena Trusova, a drider ballerina whose graceful dance is as deadly as it is beautiful.

Madam Vyper, a marilith seamstress who crafts dresses from the skin, bones, and remains of her human sacrifices.

Mia, Kalia, and Anya, three angelic sisters.

Nissa, a necromancer siren capable of summoning corpses.

Balatra, a chaotic and sadistic harpy whose unpredictable nature turns every battle into a nightmare.

Yin-Yan, the embodiment of death itself.

Story & Narrative

Between battles, uncover the secrets of the world through visual novel-inspired story sequences.

Learn about Astrid's past, the motivations of the dungeon's guardians, and the consequences of an obsession powerful enough to challenge the natural order of life and death.

How far would someone go to bring back the one they love?

Features

  • Intense 2D shoot ’em up gameplay.

  • Boss rush-focused game structure.

  • Multiple phases and attack patterns for every boss battle.

  • Dark story with visual novel-style narrative.

  • Horror atmosphere and macabre fantasy themes.

  • English and Spanish language support.

  • Designed as a short but memorable experience.

Credits

Created by
Victoria "Cataxis" Pérez

2D Art
Zathyna, Mick MacLijn, Flower Eye Art, Raven Curry

3D Art
.hakun. & Nessa Art

UI
Kodashi

Music
LosthinK & Jimena Contreras

Voice Acting

Astrid (Child) — Melina Sofia Carol

Public Relations Frik-In

Legal Consultant Jacobo Castañeda

Supported by Latinx In Gaming, Squid Makes & ASUS

Content Warning

Dungeon Killer contains graphic violence, dismemberment, corpses, gore, themes of death, grief, depression, and disturbing content. Recommended for mature audiences only.

data.short_description: Dungeon Killer is a fast-paced boss rush shoot ’em up where you play as Astrid, a woman determined to bargain with the goddess of death herself to resurrect her husband. Armed with a minigun, you’ll descend into a hellish dungeon and face deadly, disturbing female enemies.
